description: First-order formulas satisfy \((\varphi\to\psi)\equiv(\neg\varphi\lor\psi)\) under classical semantics.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.imp_iff_not_sup.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {T : L.Theory} {α : Type w}
  {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : L.BoundedFormula α n) : T.Iff (φ.imp ψ) (φ.not ⊔ ψ)
